title: Subscription Plans
snippet:
# **Free Tier**
- **Cost:** $0
- **Description:** Ideal for users just getting started with Consensus. The Free tier gives you access to essential search functionalities, allowing you to explore and familiarize yourself with the platform.
- **Features:**
- Unlimited Papers searches per month
- 10 Pro messages per month
- 3 Deep reviews per month
- 10 Study Snapshots per month
- 30 included [API & MCP](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/) calls per month
---
# **Pro Subscription**
- **Cost:** $20/month or $144/year (billed annually, equivalent to $12/month)
- **Description:** Our most popular plan! Pro unlocks unlimited Pro Searches plus 15 Deep Searches per month. It’s ideal for users who want full access to advanced AI features for deeper, evidence-based insights.
- **Features:**
- Unlimited Papers searches per month
- Unlimited Pro messages per month
- 15 Deep reviews per month
- Unlimited Study Snapshots
- 500 included [API & MCP](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/) calls per month

A call is one request per 100 papers returned (20 papers = 1 call, 150 papers = 2 calls). Paid plans can turn on additional usage at $0.05 per call. The API and the [Consensus MCP server](https://github.com/Consensus-NLP/consensus-mcp) share one monthly pool. Details: [API plans and access](https://docs.consensus.app/api-plans-and-access). title: Full text in the API
snippet:
| **Which papers** | Open access only. Threads can also quote paywalled papers they cite | Open access only. Other papers come back `blocked` |
| **Plans** | Paid plans (Pro, Deep, Teams, Enterprise) | Paid plans (Pro, Deep, Teams, Enterprise) |
| **Cost** | Included in the search | 1 credit per paper returned |

### Credits
Complete text costs **1 credit per paper returned**. A credit counts the same as a call against your plan’s monthly allowance, which the API and MCP share.
- **Free:** papers that come back blocked, not found, or `no_full_text`.
- **Charged once a day:** a paper charged to you in the last 24 hours, through the API or MCP, comes back again for free, so retrying after a response doesn’t charge twice. This is best effort: a reread before `free_reread_until` can still be charged, for example when the first charge didn’t complete. A request for the same paper sent before the first one has finished is charged too, so wait for a response before you retry.
- **Hold first, settle after:** before reading, the request reserves 1 credit for each paper that could be charged. If that doesn’t fit in your remaining allowance, the whole request returns `429` and nothing is charged. After the response, you pay only for the papers returned. `credits_charged` shows what the request is priced at; the usage it counts can be lower, since a request that crosses your included allowance is counted only up to it, and a charge that fails counts nothing.
Complete text needs a paid plan: Pro, Deep, Teams, or Enterprise. On a Free plan the request returns `403` `feature_not_allowed`. See [plans and access](/api-plans-and-access#how-calls-are-counted).

title: docs.consensus.app/api-reference/search.md
snippet:
description: >-
Search usage is billed in calls: one call per 100 papers returned, rounded
up, with a minimum of 1 call per request. Usage counts against your plan's
included monthly calls. Free plans include 30 calls per month, Pro and Teams
plans include 500, and Deep plans include 2,000. Paid plans with an active
metered API subscription may continue past the included limit; additional
calls are billed at $0.05 per call. Enterprise API keys have unlimited
access.
